title: PRONE: Petrov-Galerkin Operator Learning Unifies DMD, SINDy & Koopmanism
summary: Data-driven dynamics often asks how to linearize a nonlinear system. We ask instead: which observables should be advanced, and where should their futures live? This leads to Petrov Regression Of Nonlinear Evolution (PRONE), a Petrov--Galerkin regression framework based on $ Ψ(\mathbf{X})K \approx Φ(\mathbf{Y}), $ with distinct trial and test dictionaries. In this form, DMD, EDMD, SINDy, Koopman regression, sparse regression, and low-rank regression become variants of one construction: different dictionaries, weights, and constraints.
